question.text: Which Greek measures the sensitivity of an option's price to changes in the volatility of the underlying?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines Vega as the sensitivity of the option price to changes in market volatility and provides the corresponding formula. The Trap: Delta measures sensitivity to the underlying price, Theta to the passage of time, and Rho to changes in the risk-free interest rate. Note: Vega is positive for long options, meaning long calls and long puts both gain value when volatility rises.
